description: Returns upcoming live NOGA classes with times (Eastern), spots left, price, and the ids needed to book.

class_name.description: Optional class to filter by, e.g. 'Pilates+ Mat Class', 'Reformer', 'Define'.

days.description: How many days to show. Default 7.

from_date.description: First day to show, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: get_class_schedule
title: Live class schedule
